name: Dual bar
goal: {{task}} Ship when this holds: {{ship-line}} Aim toward: {{aspiration}}

template.title: Dual bar
template.summary: A builder and an isolated critic loop against two lines: a reachable ship line that stops the loop, and an aspiration that only steers the findings.
template.whenToUse: The work needs both a ship line and a directional aspiration: good enough to ship is clear, and better is worth pointing at without ever blocking.
template.notFor: Work where only the aspiration is written down; a bar that cannot be met never stops, so write the ship line first.

slots.ask: What should be built or changed? One or two sentences a builder can act on.
slots.example: Add a GET /users/:id endpoint to the API in src/api/.

slots.ask: What must be true to ship? A reachable line the critic can check.
slots.example: `pnpm test` passes, GET /users/:id returns 404 for unknown ids, and the README documents the endpoint.

slots.ask: What would great look like? Direction only: it never blocks shipping.
slots.example: A new contributor can use the endpoint correctly from the README alone, on the first try.

description: A builder works and a frontier critic in a fresh context reports against both lines of the bar. The acceptance (the ship line) decides the verdict; the aspiration only ranks what to improve next and never fails a round. The loop stops when the ship line holds, when two rounds bring no improvement, after five rounds, or at fifty turns.

nodes.name: Builder
nodes.brief: Do the task until the ship line holds, then spend any remaining rounds on the aspiration findings the critic ranks highest. Run `{{test-command}}` before you report; on a later round, start from REVIEW.md.

nodes.name: Critic
nodes.brief: Judge the change against both lines of the bar and say, with file and line, where it stands on each. The ship line alone decides the verdict: pass when it holds. The aspiration never fails a round; use it only to rank what to improve next. You judge; you do not fix.
outputs: REVIEW.md: the ship line item by item, then ranked aspiration findings, then a verdict line
